name: windows-terminal
title: Windows Terminal
description: Launch and manage Windows Terminal instances

commands.name: open-profile
commands.title: Open Profile
commands.description: Creates a new Windows Terminal instance for a profile
commands.subtitle: Windows Terminal

commands.name: open-with-terminal
commands.title: Open with Terminal
commands.description: Open the currently selected file manager item with Terminal

preferences.name: openProfilesInQuakeWindow
preferences.title: Quake Window
preferences.label: Open profiles in quake window
preferences.description: When enabled, profile launches (primary action and Open as Administrator) open inside Windows Terminal's quake (drop-down) window.

preferences.name: useNewTabMenu
preferences.title: New Tab Menu
preferences.label: Use New Tab Menu order
preferences.description: When enabled, shows profiles in the order defined by Windows Terminal's New Tab Menu setting (newTabMenu in settings.json) instead of the raw profile list order.
